info.title: epub-post-processor
info.description: Post-process EPUB files for different publishing destinations.

commands.name: rewrite
commands.description: Create one EPUB per storefront configuration.

options.name: --config
options.description: YAML files or directories; repeat --config or supply several paths.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing store EPUBs. The source is always preserved. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Validate all configurations and links without creating any outputs. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show each link match and replacement, grouped by store. [default: False]
